summary.text: Adam Prior is the Republican candidate for the New Mexico House of Representatives, District 44, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A general contractor from Rio Rancho, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is focused on public safety, education and water infrastructure.

paragraphs.text: Adam Prior graduated from El Toro High School and works as a contractor.

In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described him as a father in Rio Rancho and a small business owner who works as a commercial and residential general contractor focusing on roofs, stucco and remodeling.
Prior advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
He listed three key messages in the survey: public safety and safe communities, improving children's education and parents' say in it, and improving water infrastructure.
He also said New Mexico should offer trade schools for young adults and become a place where businesses and individuals want to come, build and stay.
